exposure: Induction of labor with Prostaglandin E2
Spontaneous onset of labor vs. induction of labor
Prolonged premature rupture of membranes (>24 h)
prolonged (>24 h) premature rupture of membranes
cohort: 625 women with term (≥37 weeks) premature rupture of membranes and Bishop-score <7
finding: Women with prolonged premature rupture of membranes who underwent induction of labor had a significantly higher risk of cesarean section, particularly due to labor dystocia, compared to those with spontaneous onset of labor, but neonatal outcomes were similar.
mod_finding: Women undergoing induction of labor for prolonged term PROM were at increased risk for cesarean section compared to those with spontaneous onset of labor.
